commit_subject: (screen-flagged) b1.6 (PR #1300): removes hard-coded exemplar entry_is_line_a..e derived rules (proof atoms citing other chapters' HTS lines) from every generated chapter and makes them caller inputs; summary claims runtime semantics unchanged — unsure, part of the same decoupling repair.
description: The generated compositions move from the witness's five per-line exemplar flags to membership-semantic caller inputs

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: The chapter 39 composition defined its five entry-incidence flags as equality against exemplar HTS lines from chapters 72, 76, 95, 22 and 85, conditions with no basis in chapter 39's cited provisions, so the §301/§232/§201/§338 and reciprocal-exclusion branches reading them could never fire for a chapter-39 entry.
triage.triage_notes: Same pattern as index 36; diff read and confirmed to be only the summary hunk plus removal of the five exemplar derived rules. Kind reasoning identical to index 36.
triage.verifier_justification: The whole ch39 diff is the summary rewrite plus deletion of five derived rules whose formulas were `hts_number == "7202.11.10.00"` (ch. 72 ferroalloy), `"7601.10.30.00"` (ch. 76 aluminum), `"9506.62.40.40"` (ch. 95 footballs), `"2203.00.00.30"` (ch. 22 beer) and `"8541.42.00.10"` (ch. 85 PV cells) — conditions that can never be true inside a composition that computes over `ch39_general_rate[hts_line]`, so they are branch conditions with no basis in chapter 39's cited provisions and the fix removes them. They are live, not dead code: post-fix the same identifiers still gate `section_301_component_rate` ("if entry_is_line_a and origin_is_china: list_1_additional_ad_valorem_rate ..."), the §232 aluminum component ("elif entry_is_line_b:"), `section_338_component_rate`, and the reciprocal annex/metals exclusions, so pre-fix every §301/§232/§338 branch was structurally zero and every metals exclusion structurally never fired for a chapter-39 entry; deleting the definitions turns them into caller inputs and changes those outcomes. The PR's own framing corroborates a meaning defect rather than a refactor ("the witness's exemplar coupling, which round-2 evaluation showed unlawfully suppressed the surcharge on §301-member lines for all origins"), and the module's boilerplate "changes no formula tokens ... or runtime values" is stale — it deletes five rules and their proof atoms, so mechanical does not survive. Only refutation I could mount was "pilot scope the module never claimed", which fails because the module is declared as the chapter-39 composition and emits duty components for chapter-39 entries.
triage.verifier_notes: Verified against full pre/post files (git show 956a547418 / 2a6bdb01de of us/policies/cbp/us-tariff-schedule/generated/ch39/ch39.yaml). Three caveats for the reviewer. (1) The first reader's list of affected branches is slightly over-broad: the §201 branch is degenerate, "if entry_is_line_e: 0 else: 0", so its never-firing had no numeric effect; §301, §232 aluminum and §338 are genuinely dead pre-fix. (2) The defect cuts both directions — the §301/§232/§338 inclusions were stuck at zero (under-duty), while the metals/annex exclusions "if entry_is_line_a or entry_is_line_b: 0 else: temporary_import_surcharge_rate" never fired (over-duty). Neither is a polarity inversion; the conditions themselves are ungrounded, so untraceable_branch fits better than polarity_or_logic, and better than wrong_entity_or_scope since the rubric puts "formulas grounded on the wrong provision" under untraceable_branch. (3) The repair is incomplete at this commit: `entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded` still reads `formula: entry_is_line_a` with a proof atom excerpt "7202.11.10", entry_is_line_c/e are still referenced, and source_verification still lists the exemplar lines 7202.11.10.00 / 7601.10.30.00 / 9506.62.40.40 / 2203.00.00.30 / 8541.42.00.10. The membership-semantic rename and the §232 steel component the PR body describes are not in this ch39 diff (124 lines, 100 removed) — they landed in #1298 or later commits of the same PR, so do not credit this module change with them.
